snippet.title: Mik Demo Trailer: OUT NOW
snippet.description:
Play on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2547010/Mik/
Join discord: https://discord.gg/VYUedn5bWE 
Support me on patreon: https://patreon.com/stefaaan

Game & OST by me


Mik is an atmospheric, narrative-driven platformer, set in a post-apocalyptic world. What was once a thriving megastructure is now a rotting corpse of a facility, where you find yourself exploring fragments of the past.
